text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Placed on the board... Just one step away, 
wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I've put in the work. I've prepared 
thoroughly for my opponent, too. Even so, 
just one step further was...
choice_data_list: You fought so well out there!
You fought so well out there!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, thank you. But I can't just be 
content staying here.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"The razor-thin margin that divides 
destiny. I believe bridging that gap is 
what leads down the path to becoming the 
'strongest'!"
choice_data_list: Then you know what to do, right?
Then you know what to do, right?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, I think about it. How to 
achieve a resounding victory— I think, and 
think, and think it all the way through—"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That's the only way to bridge the gap in 
talent!
choice_data_list:
As long as you understand that, you'll be 
fine!

As long as you understand that, you'll be 
fine!

text_block_list.text:

talent!

As long as you understand that, you'll be

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That's true. An Umamusume like me has no 
choice but to learn through trial and 
error.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
No more moping around! I'll produce you so 
you can take a flawless victory next time!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: So make sure you keep up with me, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good. Let's do a thorough review of 
today's race, from the paddock, during the 
run, all the way to the post-race 
cooldown.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
If you don't apply all your experience to 
what comes next, you can hardly call 
yourself a producer, after all.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
And so, we're going to pack it all in 
tight. Are you ready, Trainer?
